transitions.statement: Four measurement cultures reconciled once per project and discarded, to one reconciliation that is published and reused
transitions.source_ref: Concept note, 'The gap the topic names'

transitions.statement: Habitat labels that stop at the project boundary, to labels that carry a crosswalk to the European classification and the global typology
transitions.source_ref: Concept note, 'The chain, from genome to space'

transitions.statement: Three unconnected demonstration sites, to three realms on one pressure gradient that test the same harmonisation decision
transitions.source_ref: Concept note, 'Three demonstration cases on one gradient'

transitions.statement: A field archive readable only by the group that made it, to a documented training and validation resource with a declared split protocol
Case-scale habitat maps, to European coverage and trend prediction built on the case models
Biodiversity indicators that reach a research portal, to indicators inside the farm-management tools of the sector that creates the pressure

outcomes.statement: One multisensory integration architecture carries omics, in-situ, airborne and satellite observation, and it is specified from a prioritised account of what is missing rather than of what is available.
outcomes.note: The gap analysis is the outcome's load-bearing half. An architecture designed around the data that happens to exist reproduces the gap the topic describes.

outcomes.statement: A joint protocol set, a crosswalk package and a provenance-tracked pipeline make the project's harmonisation decisions usable outside it, and the decisions reach the bodies that maintain the classifications.

Three demonstration cases on one agricultural pressure gradient produce comparable observation datasets across the terrestrial, freshwater and marine realms, and a report says which harmonisation decisions survived the transfer.
outcomes.note: The verification report is the outcome, not the three datasets. Three datasets that never met would answer the realm requirement and not the integration claim.

outcomes.statement: The molecular layer joins the in-situ and remote-sensing record through a published metadata standard, so a genomic observation and a satellite observation of the same place can be queried together.
outcomes.source_ref: Objectives O1 and O4; call extract span SRC-WP9-P74#792-847

outcomes.statement: A documented training and validation resource with a declared split protocol lets an external group reproduce the project's benchmarks and test its own models against them.
outcomes.source_ref: Objectives O3; call extract span SRC-WP9-P74#952-985

outcomes.statement: Habitat and ecosystem classification runs at European coverage, and biodiversity trend predictions carry the uncertainty the case benchmarks measured.
outcomes.source_ref: Objectives O5; call extract span SRC-WP9-P74#1089-1164

outcomes.statement: Competent authorities receive outputs shaped to the reporting obligations they carry, and agricultural holdings receive biodiversity indicators inside the tools they already use.
outcomes.source_ref: Objectives O6; call extract spans SRC-WP9-P75#1447-1556 and SRC-WP9-P74#1948-2035

coverage.note: The call extract records the outcome list as binding: project results are expected to contribute to all three. Each is answered by at least two outcomes.
